description: Retrieve compact historical trade analogues for the current market state. Plans are deterministic synthetic templates, while fills, stop/target ordering, MAE/MFE and outcomes are settled on later historical candles with costs. Use it to compare similar wins and failures, never as proof of an edge.

bars.description: History per symbol. Default 1500; min 300, max 3000.

feeBps.description: Fee per side. Default 4 basis points.

ref.description: Optional market_candles handle for the query state.

slippageBps.description: Adverse slippage per side. Default 1 basis point.

stride.description: Evaluate one signal point every N bars. Default 4.

symbol.description: Query symbol; defaults to the chart.

symbols.description: Optional same-venue peer corpus. Query symbol is always included.

timeframe.description: Query timeframe; defaults to the chart.

name: trade_experience_retrieve
